pages.title: Atmosphere Shard
pages.text: Frozen air, mined from thin crystalline sheets on the Phase 6 surface.

pages.title: Sublimation
pages.text: Above $(bold)-150°C$() body temperature, a carried shard $(danger)vanishes in about 7.5 s$(). It shimmers and sheds snowflakes first.

pages.title: Storage
pages.text: A $(l:heating/thermal_container)Thermal Container$(/l) stops the timer; stored shards keep forever.$(li)Mine it$(li)Open the container$(li)Put it inside$(li)Do not panic$(br2)$(flavor)If you panicked, see step 4.$()
$(flavor)You are holding the sky. ORSA recommends not thinking about it.$()$(br2)$(flavor)"A rescue beacon that needs frozen sky. In hindsight, copper wire would have worked." Dr. Vasquez$()
